changes.content:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: shearbolt
        uses: klar-web-services/shearbolt@v1
        with:
          working-directory: apps/api
      - run: npm ci && npm test
        working-directory: apps/api
  web:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Build web image
        id: shearbolt-build
        run: |
          docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t ghcr.io/acme/web:${{ github.sha }} -t ghcr.io/acme/web:shearbolt-${{ github.sha }} apps/web
          echo shearbolt-image=ghcr.io/acme/web:shearbolt-${{ github.sha }} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: shearbolt
        uses: klar-web-services/shearbolt@v1
        env:
          SHEARBOLT_IMAGE: ${{ steps.shearbolt-build.outputs.shearbolt-image }}
        with:
          working-directory: apps/web
      - name: Push web image
        run: docker push ghcr.io/acme/web:${{ github.sha }}
  cli:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: crates/cli
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Install cargo-auditable
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-auditable
      - run: cargo auditable build --release --locked
      - name: shearbolt
        uses: klar-web-services/shearbolt@v1
        with:
          working-directory: crates/cli
